articles.title: The Venice Art Biennale: Quietly criticising Israel
articles.summary: Fortunately for anyone who abhors artwashing, the curating of the art biennial has made it impossible to ignore the crimes committed by Israel in Palestine and beyond

articles.title: Can Pakistan-administered Kashmir elections calm tensions?
articles.summary: Pakistan-administered Kashmir heads to the polls after weeks of deadly protests over seats reserved for displaced people from India-administered Kashmir. One local group has called for the election to be boycotted.
